author: Nationwide
text:
ARCH/PRINCIPLES amendment: excise user-action resume; lernie advance

Drops `lernie resume` and the user-action "resume" from the architecture
and collapses §6's `lernie event <name>` and `lernie resume <repo>` into
a single rederive-from-state primitive `lernie advance <repo>`. Adds two
explicit §6 invariants: workflow position is derivable from disk; every
procedure invoked by `lernie advance` is idempotent under replay.

Sections amended: ARCH §1 #4, §2.3 (Resume note), §2.4, §2.9, §3.5, §6.
PRINCIPLES Regenerability. bl-c0a5 done-when amended via note.

Docs-only — no code references the affected CLI subcommands.
